resolved_tensions.issue: ActorAccessibleRenderEnvelope is an exact semantic ceiling but downstream expression must retain lawful situational variability.
resolved_tensions.resolution: The envelope authorizes semantic material and permission only. Separately governed V2 salience, disclosure willingness, inhibition, affective foregrounding, interlocutor-specific openness, interaction mode, register and wording may select/narrow among allowed material but cannot create or widen claims.

resolved_tensions.issue: Exact deny/defer refs may carry identity necessary for control while denied/withheld semantic content must remain unrecoverable.
resolved_tensions.resolution: ActorSafeNonrenderableDecisionRef is control-only. Its claim ref/payload is not behaviorally dereferenceable by V2; deny/defer creates zero positive claim semantics.

resolved_tensions.issue: Replay closure is identity/integrity critical but may contain upstream provenance.
resolved_tensions.resolution: The replay closure root is carried only as an OpaqueAuditRef. Exact hash verification is allowed for integrity/audit; payload, metadata and upstream refs cannot affect model-visible or behavioral selection.

resolved_tensions.issue: Transcript/session continuity may preserve old text after V3 accessibility changes.
resolved_tensions.resolution: Currentness is controlled only by the exact V3 bound hashes/ADP-017 binding. Session/transcript state cannot restore or substitute a stale/withdrawn actor-safe entry.

resolved_tensions.issue: An admitted external occurrence might be mistaken for automatic memory/knowledge/belief mutation.
resolved_tensions.resolution: ADMIT creates exactly the admitted occurrence only. Further V3 actor effects require their separate owning rules; REJECT/DEFER/INVALID create zero V3 mutation and zero causal cursor advance.
